title: Inhuman: Supreme Court denies anticipatory bail to Kerala professor Dr. MK Ram in Dalit student suicide case
description: The Supreme Court on Monday rejected the appeal filed by Kannur Dental College professor, Dr. M Kodanda Ram, who is accused of verbally harassing a Dalit student, Nithin Raj, who died by suicide in April [Dr. M Kodanda Ram v State of Kerala & ors].A Bench of Justices Vikram Nath and Sandeep Mehta termed the professor's conduct as inhuman and underscored that he cannot walk away without facing consequences."Inhuman is the only word that comes to mind.
